What Coaches & Athletes Are Saying

“Coming from USC to the professional circuit in 2026 was a big change. I found it challenging moving from the college system to the pro tour, but using SPARC gave me a daily system where I could continually evaluate myself mentally. It allowed me to analyse my mental game after close matches and therefore meant I was training my mental part of the game more regularly.

Also the journaling part of SPARC helped me prepare before matches and consistently evaluate myself with a daily check in. I’ve only been on the pro circuit from January but can feel that SPARC has made a positive impact to my tennis journey and I will continue to use the app to improve my game.”
Oscar Weightman
Former DI Athlete - University of Southern California
ATP-Ranked Professional Tennis Player
“Over the past year of using SPARC we've noticed significant improvements as a college team. It has been helpful in giving us data to guide both mental performance work and on-court training. The match logging and reflection features have been especially valuable in helping our athletes learn from their experiences and improve over time, which is the key to sustainable growth.”
Eric Spangler
Head Coach, Haverford Men's Tennis
Since we started using the SPARC app, we’ve collectively noticed a real difference in our TEAM’s overall on-court mindset.  Kid’s focus has sharpened significantly — they seem to stay on task longer without mentally drifting off.
Our point patience has also improved, especially during important moments or critical points throughout the match.  Player’s demeanors seem calmer and more composed.
As a coach, my favorite feature is having insight into player’s minds as they journal their post match thoughts.  This allows me to individually see what a player maybe doing well, or what they may need help with.
SPARC has become a simple but powerful tool in our routine. I highly recommend it to any player or coach looking to strengthen or improve their mental game.  
Corey Aldridge
Head Coach, Southlake Carroll HS Tennis
"SPARC changed how I approach competition. What once felt abstract became clear. I could see exactly where I was losing my edge between points and train it."
Antonio Muniz-Hidalgo

"SPARC tennis app is great for any player wanting to improve and understand the mental side of the game. It is not easy to have high amounts of pressure while not having someone/something to use for those specific emotions in those moments. It’s helped me a lot!”
Harry Thursfield

“Tennis is a sport where narrow margins matter. In big moments, confidence and focus define whether you win or lose. SPARC gave me structured insights into my mental patterns; it showed me not just what I felt under pressure, but why and how to improve it.
SPARC’s tailored training modules helped me convert stress into strategy using routines. The result wasn’t just improved mindfulness; it was better outcomes in match play, especially in tight sets. For an athlete competing at this level, that edge is the difference between good and great.”

“Since I started using SPARC, my mental tennis game has completely transformed. The app’s targeted exercises help me stay focused during matches, manage pressure, and recover quickly from mistakes. SPARC has turned mental toughness from something I struggled with into a real competitive advantage. I personally really like this app because it allows me to learn through all of the different subcategories under mental strength. “At this level, consistency is everything. SPARC helped me build mental routines that I reliably come back to in times of pressure.  It turned my mindset into more of a skill.”

ATP-Ranked Professional Tennis Player
“I've been using SPARC mostly for keeping notes post match/practice to remind myself of things that went well and things that I need to work on. It's also a convenient place to put pre-match reminders and affirmations, meditations, and quotes that help frame my mind in a positive and calm way.”
Eric Kuo
NCAA Athlete - Washington University in St Louis
“I built SPARC because I realized the mental side was deciding most of my matches. In tennis, nearly 80% of your time is spent between points, not hitting the ball. The real battle is winning those in-between moments. The same situations repeat: you get nervous, you miss, you feel frustrated. That’s inevitable. What separates players is how quickly they reset. I use SPARC to train my between-point routines so I have skills to rely on under pressure. The strokes are always there. It’s allowing yourself the mental space to access them.”

Built With Licensed Sport Psychologists

A structured mental performance system developed with licensed experts who train athletes at the highest levels of sport.

Dr. Tess Kilwein, PhD, CMPC

Board-certified clinical, health, and sport psychologist licensed nationwide through PSYPACT®. Recognized by the U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Committee, MLBPA, and NFLPA, and former sport psychologist for Vanderbilt Athletics.

SPARC's framework is grounded in their evidence-based, trauma-informed performance expertise.
Dr. Grayson Kimball, CMPC

Mental performance coach with 20+ years of experience supporting Olympic, professional, collegiate, and youth athletes. Associate Professor of Sport Psychology at National University and longtime lecturer at Northeastern University.

Dr. Kimball brings research-backed, practical mental skills systems into SPARC—designed to help athletes perform consistently under pressure.
